description: Screenshot of a verified Elon Musk (@elonmusk) tweet from December 22, 2017 with the joking caption 'Nuclear alien UFO from North Korea' over a video still of a glowing spiral exhaust plume in a dark night sky. The plume is the SpaceX Falcon 9 Iridium-4 launch seen over Southern California that evening; Musk's caption is a joke about the UFO reports it prompted.
text: Elon Musk. @elonmusk. Follow. Nuclear alien UFO from North Korea. 0:22. 1.78M views. 8:50 PM - 22 Dec 2017. 39,873 Retweets. 102,782 Likes
flags: 'Nuclear alien UFO from North Korea' is Musk's joke caption, not a factual claim; the plume is a SpaceX launch
Iridium-4/Southern California identification inferred from the well-documented Dec 22 2017 launch, not stated in the image
